name: R R Kabel Ltd
tagline: India's #3 wires & cables player, already re-rated ~2.4x over the past year with new conglomerate competition (Adani, Birla) now entering the category
business_overview: RR Kabel manufactures wires & cables (~87-89% of revenue) and FMEG products - fans, lighting, switches (~11-13% of revenue, growing faster at 32% YoY). Listed Sep 2023. Currently India's #3 player behind Polycab and KEI.
fundamentals_table: Rs 32,754 Cr (up 138% in the last 1 year)
Rs 1,165.1 - 2,925 (hit 52-week lows in early 2025 before the subsequent rally)
fundamentals_narrative: Strong ROCE/ROE and a fast-growing FMEG segment, but the stock has already re-rated dramatically (+138% over the last year) from the ~52-week lows it touched in early 2025. One community post from May 2026 (when market cap was ~Rs 20,000 Cr) floated a 4x-to-Rs-80,000-Cr thesis; the market cap has since already grown to ~Rs 32,754 Cr, meaning a meaningful part of that re-rating has already played out.
sentiment_summary: Read all 12 available posts spanning Feb 2024 to May 2026 - a very thin thread. Early sentiment was neutral/informational (segment mix, product launches, an Akshay Kumar ad campaign). A Feb 2025 EBITDA-margin miss across the whole cables sector (Havells, Polycab, RR Kabel) drove the stock to 52-week lows. The most consequential post (Mar 2025) flagged that Adani and Aditya Birla Group are entering the cables & wires business - a structural new-competitor risk for the entire category, with the poster noting the community was surprisingly late to flag such a major development. The final two posts (May 2026) are a bullish market-cap-growth thesis from a single untrusted user, unconfirmed/uncorroborated by anyone else in the thread.
community_signal: No trusted-roster user posted in this thread at all - all participants are non-trusted, and no conviction/position language was used by anyone.
bull_case: Strong ROCE/ROE (28.1%/21.3%) and a genuine #3-player position in a large, growing wires/cables + FMEG market
FMEG segment growing faster (32% YoY) than the core wires/cables business, a real diversification/margin lever
Company absorbed the initial competitive-entry shock from the Feb 2025 sector-wide margin miss and has since rallied substantially
bear_case: Stock has already re-rated ~138% over the past year - much of any near-term re-rating thesis may already be priced in
Adani and Aditya Birla Group entering the wires & cables category is a real, structural new-competition risk for the whole sector, not yet fully assessed by the (thin) community discussion
No trusted-roster user has engaged with this name at all - there is no community-conviction signal to corroborate the thesis
The most recent bullish call (4x market-cap thesis) came from a single non-trusted user and is significantly stale now that most of that move has already happened
verdict_headline: A quality #3 cables player that has already captured much of its near-term re-rating, now facing a real new-conglomerate competitive threat
verdict_reasoning: The stock's ~138% 1-year rally means the market has already priced in much of the growth/FMEG-mix story that would otherwise support a 10x case
Adani/Birla entry into the category is a genuine structural risk that the (very thin) community discussion has not meaningfully assessed
Absence of any trusted-user engagement leaves no community-conviction signal to lean on

four_box.note: Adani/Birla entry into the FMEG category is a genuine structural risk the thin community discussion hasn't assessed (moat=no); '~138% 1-year rally' means growth story 'already priced in' (valuation=no).
